title: Preview
start_explain: This runs the command from the project's .claude/launch.json on {machine}, in a new terminal tab. Ctrl-C there stops it.
start_slow: {name} isn't answering on :{port} yet. Check its terminal tab.
starting_detail: Waiting for something to answer on port {port}.
old_detail: Persona on {machine} is too old for previews. Update it, then open Preview again.
empty_detail: Servers the agent starts show up here. To list your own, add .claude/launch.json to the project:
problems: Entries in launch.json that can't be used
problem_not_local: its url is another computer: a preview shows this one
problem_no_run: needs runtimeExecutable or a local url
pick: Pick an element to comment on
picking: Click an element to comment on it. Esc cancels.
shot_header: Adds a PNG to your message
no_browser_detail: Previews run in a headless Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave on that computer. Install one there, or set PERSONA_CHROME to one, then try again.
port_gone_detail: The server may have stopped. Start it again, or pick another one.
external: The page wanted to open {url}. Previews stay on this computer.
leave: The page asks whether to leave it.
notice_file_chooser: The page asked for a file. Previews can't pick files yet.
no_box: This conversation takes no messages, so the element can't be sent as a comment.
